title: The constitutional isomers of C₃H₈O
caption: Three different connections of the same atoms: two alcohols and an ether. Their properties differ: propan-1-ol boils at 97 °C, propan-2-ol at 82 °C and methoxyethane at 7 °C, which has no O–H to hydrogen bond.
alt: Propan-1-ol, propan-2-ol and methoxyethane, each C₃H₈O.
description: Propan-1-ol: OH on the end carbon.
Propan-2-ol: OH on the middle carbon.
